footnote_text: Represents an award of (i) 500,000 restricted stock units (RSUs), which vest on the earlier of (A) May 18, 2027, and (B) the conclusion of the reporting person's employment as Interim Chief Executive Officer, provided that he is not terminated by the issuer for "cause" and does not resign prior to the end of the term specified in the reporting person's offer letter, and (ii) 1,500,000 RSUs, which vest in twelve equal monthly installments beginning on December 18, 2026, subject to his continued service as Interim Chief Executive Officer through the applicable vesting date. Each RSU represents a contingent right to receive one share of Common Stock. The RSUs do not expire.
